description: Data models for the Home screen scaffolding, including definitions for navigation items, progress indicators, content cards, hero items, and rail sections.

classes.name: NavItem
classes.description: Represents a top navigation item with an id, title, and active state.

classes.name: Progress
classes.description: Represents a progress indicator with current and total values, and calculates a ratio.

classes.name: CardItem
classes.description: Represents a content card with optional image URL and progress.

classes.name: HeroItem
classes.description: Represents a large hero item with optional image URL.

classes.name: RailSection
classes.description: Represents a horizontally scrollable section with a list of CardItems.

methods.name: Progress
methods.description: Constructors and properties for Progress class; ratio is calculated based on current and total.
